description: Explores sitcom engines built from recurring, incompatible character desires, comparing premise-, character-, and story-driven episodes and recurrence versus serialization. Examines writers’ room revision, single- and multi-camera production, reaction shots, editing, and laughter cues as ways to develop a durable comic world.
